user.title: Connect Grok Bot
user.description: Create a webhook routine in the Grok Bot app, then paste its webhook URL and the full Authorization header value. Every message Home Assistant sends to this webhook costs Grok Bot usage.

data.name: Name
data.send_test: Send a test ping (counts as one Grok Bot run)

data_description.webhook_url: The https:// URL of the Grok Bot routine webhook.
data_description.auth_header: Paste the value exactly as shown in the app (for example `Bearer …`). It is stored as a secret and never logged.
data_description.send_test: Checks the URL and header by posting {"type": "ping"}.

preset.title: What may Grok Bot receive?
preset.description: Pick a starting point. You can change it any time in the options; nothing is sent automatically unless you allow it.

data_description.preset: Custom unlocks Advanced mode with every option.

reauth_confirm.title: Grok Bot authorization failed
reauth_confirm.description: The webhook rejected the Authorization header. Paste the current value from the Grok Bot app.

init.title: Grok Bot options
init.description: Mode: {mode}. Preset: {preset}. Every send costs Grok Bot usage and counts toward your budget.

menu_options.budget: Budget, rate limits and quiet hours

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Ask only: only your own actions, buttons and the card send. Errors only: logged errors, failed automations and failed integrations are reported. Errors + repairs, diagnose: also repair issues, and Grok Bot investigates each one. Custom: Advanced mode.

features.title: Features
features.description: Inbound webhook path (only when enabled, POST JSON with `message`): {webhook_path}

data_description.enable_conversation: Assist answers right away that the message was sent; Grok Bot's real answer arrives later.
data_description.enable_inbound_webhook: Lets Grok Bot post replies to a secret Home Assistant webhook as well as calling grok_bot.reply.
data_description.include_attributes: Off sends only states, which keeps payloads small.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Sends over the budget are dropped, not queued. Manual actions count too, unless they set bypass_budget.

data.min_interval: Minimum seconds between forwards of the same entity or event

forwarding.title: State and event forwarding
forwarding.description: Only the entities and event types you pick here are forwarded. Leave empty to forward nothing.

data_description.forward_events: Type an event type and press Enter, e.g. `zha_event`. state_changed and grok_bot_* events are blocked.

entity_filter.title: Per-entity filter
entity_filter.description: Pick a forwarded entity to add or change its filter.

filter_details.title: Filter for {entity_id}
filter_details.description: Without a filter every state change is forwarded (after the minimum interval). Thresholds fire when the value crosses into the range.

data.to_states: Only when the new state is one of
data.attribute: Use this attribute instead of the state

watchers.title: Problem watchers
watchers.description: Each watcher is off until you enable it. Choose per watcher whether Grok Bot only reports, diagnoses, or may try safe fixes.

data.watch_setup: Forward integrations that fail to set up

templates.title: Message templates
templates.description: Optional Jinja templates for the `message` field. Leave empty for the built-in text. Variables: state: `entity_id`, `from_state`, `to_state`; event: `event_type`, `event_data`; problems: `kind`, `issue`.

error.hour_over_day: The hourly limit can't be higher than the daily limit.
error.event_blocked: One of these event types can't be forwarded.

abort.no_forward_entities: Pick entities under State and event forwarding first.
